inputs.description: Filtro PHPUnit o nombre de prueba

tasks.label: PHP: Check completo
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer check

tasks.label: PHP: Todas las pruebas
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer test

tasks.label: PHP: Unit
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer test-unit

tasks.label: PHP: Feature
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer test-feature

tasks.label: PHP: Prueba específica
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app php artisan test --filter "${input:testFilter}"

tasks.label: PHP: Pint validar
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer lint

tasks.label: PHP: Pint corregir
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer lint-fix

tasks.label: PHP: PHPStan
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app composer analyse

tasks.label: Laravel: Rutas
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app php artisan route:list

tasks.label: Laravel: Limpiar cachés
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app php artisan optimize:clear

tasks.label: Frontend: Build
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app npm run build

tasks.label: Frontend: Desarrollo
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T app npm run dev
